scenes.title: 一、行至獅駝城門下，妖氣沖天滿城魔
scenes.scene: Blue-maned lion demon in jade armor sits on cavern floor pleading with open paws; through a separate abstract golden cloud, tiny Wukong in red scarf listens, with no anatomy. No other pilgrims.

scenes.title: 二、錦繡彩轎突翻倒，陷阱四開落深壕
scenes.scene: A huge comic sneeze sends intact Sun Wukong with red scarf tumbling safely out in a spiral of mist before the blue lion demon. Silver elephant and gold-winged roc look astonished; rocky clearing, no injury.

scenes.title: 三、三魔聯手齊撲殺，八戒沙僧困重圍
scenes.scene: On mountain ground a silver elephant demon and golden-winged roc bow to Sun Wukong and promise safe passage, while their blue-maned lion brother sits looking embarrassed. No other pilgrims.

scenes.title: 四、金翅大鵬扇巨翅，一翅九萬追行者
scenes.scene: Forest clearing reunion: Tang monk in red patchwork kasaya greets returning Wukong with relief, while pig Bajie in blue and bearded Wujing in moss-green look surprised. White horse standing beside them.

scenes.title: 五、神爪一探如鐵鉗，抓住大聖摔塵埃
scenes.scene: An ornate gold-roofed Chinese sedan chair is carried along a mountain trail with the travel party, watched by red-scarfed Wukong on a low cloud. A dark walled city appears on horizon, no attack yet.

scenes.title: 六、師徒四人同受難，大鐵蒸籠熱氣騰
scenes.scene: The golden-winged roc swoops out above a city gate; Sun Wukong blocks the roc's decorative polearm with a red staff. Below at a distance Tang monk's party is surprised beside the sedan. Keep everyone intact.

scenes.title: 七、八戒落淚哭無門，大聖暗中思脫身
scenes.scene: Wide panorama of Lion Camel City at dusk, surrounded by concentric groups of tiny animal-faced guards and many fluttering flags, while three pilgrims look for a route through. No battle contact.

scenes.title: 一、夜深人靜搬假屍，謊傳唐僧入妖腹
scenes.scene: Monkey King with golden fur and red scarf deflects golden-winged roc's ornate halberd on a cobblestone street while groups of little animal-faced guards close in behind round shields, no injuries.

scenes.title: 二、骨頭扔在柴堆旁，八戒抱頭痛哭嚎
scenes.scene: Silver-white elephant demon gently curls its trunk around green-robed Sha Wujing's waist, lifting him just above the courtyard stones. In distance pink-snouted Bajie ducks away from the blue lion. No injury.

scenes.title: 三、沙僧拭淚堆土墳，大聖跌坐心欲碎
scenes.scene: Red-scarfed Sun Wukong rockets away on a pale blue somersault cloud between misty peaks; a huge golden-winged roc's shadow falls across his path as the bird catches up. Focus on sky, no other pilgrims.

scenes.title: 四、五百年來恩師情，西天路遠空遺恨
scenes.scene: A tiny shining insect escapes the open soft talons of a huge golden-winged roc in open sunset sky. The bird stares in astonishment; no other characters, focus on magical agility.

scenes.title: 五、縱身直上靈山境，佛祖座前訴悲屈
scenes.scene: An ancient palace courtyard holds a giant layered metal steamer behind closed lids and faint steam. Tang monk in red robe calmly comforts worried pig Bajie and bearded Sha as they sit together a safe distance from it, all unharmed.

scenes.title: 六、淚灑雷音悲聲切，如來微笑道端倪
scenes.scene: In a lantern-lit royal hall, three clothed animal-faced demon kings confer in a huddle, with golden-winged roc raising one finger thoughtfully while blue lion and silver-white elephant listen. Closed iron vessel in background, no children or prisoners visible.

scenes.title: 七、佛光一照洞天開，唐僧無恙安坐齋
scenes.scene: In a palace alcove a tall closed iron cabinet stands behind a curtain while gold-winged Roc whispers his plan to silver elephant and blue lion. Two small animal-faced messengers leave the hall. No violence.

scenes.title: 一、如來親駕七寶雲，五百阿羅護左右
scenes.scene: Dim stone dungeon: a tiny golden fly with magical spark approaches blue-clothed pig Bajie seated next to a big wooden column, speaking softly. Soft torchlight, theatrical and gentle, no injury.

scenes.title: 二、文殊普賢齊隨行，直降八百獅駝嶺
scenes.scene: At the crest of a lonely fog-covered mountain, Sun Wukong in ochre tunic and red scarf sits with wet eyes thinking of his teacher; quiet blue dawn, bamboo and red staff beside him, no other figures.

scenes.title: 三、青獅白象見菩薩，神光照頂現原形
scenes.scene: Monkey King arriving on a small cloud at the golden gates of Lingshan and speaking earnestly with four serene guardian figures. Warm light through mist, Chinese temple architecture, no confrontation.

scenes.title: 四、青毛獅子伏蓮座，六牙白象戴寶圈
scenes.scene: Sun Wukong kneels tearfully before the Buddha, high on a lotus throne inside the Great Thunder Monastery, calm compassion and stylized halo, quietly listening attendants distant, no other pilgrims.

scenes.title: 五、金翅大鵬展雙翅，長空翻滾戰如來
scenes.scene: The Buddha calmly tells a curious Wukong a tale, a misty cloud vignette behind them shows a luminous phoenix and a green-and-blue peacock with a golden-winged roc. Bright magical color, no battle.

scenes.title: 六、佛光萬道化肉台，大鵬原形棲佛頂
scenes.scene: Buddha and two bodhisattvas Manjushri and Samantabhadra descend on layered golden clouds over the walled Lion Camel City, Wukong in red scarf pointing out the city from the foremost cloud.

scenes.title: 七、城中救出唐長老，朗朗乾坤踏坦途
scenes.scene: Wukong leaps into a bright curtain of Buddha light above the city gate as the blue lion, silver elephant and golden-winged roc pause in awe. Distant three peaceful Buddha forms in clouds behind, no fight contact.

scenes.title: 一、比丘古國市井異，家家門口掛布籠
scenes.scene: The golden-winged roc folds his wings and perches calmly on Buddha's shoulder in radiant light while Wukong watches in awe. No raw meat or injury, blue sky above Lion Camel City.

scenes.title: 二、行者好奇掀布看，內藏無辜小幼童
scenes.scene: Four travelers reunite with relief near a now-open iron cabinet in a lantern-lit palace: Tang in red patchwork kasaya embraces Wukong, pink-snouted Bajie and bearded Sha. Tears of joy, just the four.

scenes.title: 三、驛丞暗中垂眼淚，妖道國師進讒言
scenes.scene: The four pilgrims pause outside sleepy ancient Bhikshu Kingdom's stone gate to ask a gray-haired old gatekeeper the city's name. He sits on a low stool leaning on a staff. White horse, early daylight.

scenes.title: 四、一千一百一十一，欲剖童心煉延年
scenes.scene: Straight view down a quiet ancient Chinese street in Bhikshu. Small round bamboo baskets with colorful opaque fabric covers stand by the doors. Wukong in red scarf stoops to gently lift the nearest cover, ordinary market scene, no one harmed.

scenes.title: 五、長老聞言心如絞，雙膝跪求大聖救
scenes.scene: Sun Wukong discreetly tells Tang monk in red kasaya what he saw, near a small covered bamboo basket with a child visibly sitting safe inside with room and fresh air. Beside an old Chinese doorway, pensive and gentle.

scenes.title: 六、夜半念咒召五嶽，狂風呼嘯起神霧
scenes.scene: Inside a quiet official guesthouse at night, the inn official closes a paper-lattice door and whispers gravely to Tang monk. Wukong listens with concern from a short distance, warm lantern, no other characters.

scenes.title: 七、神仙捲走千隻籠，藏身深山保平安
scenes.scene: An inn official confides in Tang monk and Wukong. A soft cloud-shaped remembered scene behind him shows the king listening to a gray-bearded Daoist and a well-dressed mysterious woman. No threatening physical acts.

scenes.title: 一、國王見籠失孩童，國師奏稱有替身
scenes.scene: On a roof overlooking the city at night, Monkey King in red scarf stands on a cloud and summons friendly mountain spirits appearing in pale gold mist above rows of roofs and covered bamboo baskets.

scenes.title: 二、十世修得好長老，唐僧之心勝千童
scenes.scene: Wind swirls over roofs of ancient Bhikshu at night. Benevolent immortals on pastel clouds magically transport covered bamboo baskets safely from the street toward a sheltered green mountain valley. No figures in distress.

scenes.title: 三、金鑾殿上宣聖僧，國王索要和尚心
scenes.scene: In an ornate Chinese throne hall a frail Bhikshu king reclines while an apparent Tang monk in red patchwork robe, actually a fully disguised Wukong with only human features, respectfully greets him. Court officials stand in rows.

scenes.title: 四、大聖暗笑變師父，昂首挺胸上朝堂
scenes.scene: A white-haired Daoist with a twisted wooden staff enters the Chinese throne hall and sits next to his frail king, surrounding officers bow. Apparent Tang monk, actually Wukong in perfect human disguise, observes quietly.

scenes.title: 五、利刃切開胸膛肉，嘩啦滾出一串心
scenes.scene: Kneeling court messenger tells an alarmed king and white-haired Daoist that the baskets are gone. The disguised Wukong appears entirely human in Tang monk's bright patchwork kasaya and listens. No injury or magic yet.

scenes.title: 六、紅心白心慈悲心，唯獨沒有黑貪心
scenes.scene: In Bhikshu throne hall the apparent Tang monk in red patchwork kasaya calmly discusses different kinds of hearts with the puzzled king. A handful of subtle heart-shaped lights suggest his words, fully clothed, no blades or physical harm.

scenes.title: 七、國師驚駭露妖氣，狂風捲起出金鑾
scenes.scene: Fully clothed Sun Wukong with monkey face and red scarf reappears in a swirl of golden light in the throne hall. A few glowing peach-pink heart-shaped sparks gently roll over the floor as the surprised white-haired Daoist flees on a cloud. No weapons, flesh, body openings or blood.

scenes.title: 一、柳林深處妖氣隱，行者八戒緊追尋
scenes.scene: Above the palace roof Wukong in red scarf confronts the fleeing white-haired Daoist on a cloud. Wukong's long red staff meets the Daoist's twisted wooden walking staff, bright stylized spark, everyone intact.

scenes.title: 二、白面狐狸美王后，原是妖道同夥魔
scenes.scene: Tang monk stands in the center of the palace, visibly regaining his human face as a small clay disguise dissolves into a wisp of light; Sun Wukong stands beside him while the king and worried women of the court ask for help. No actual fox yet.

scenes.title: 三、八戒揮耙搗狐穴，國師蟠龍杖迎風
scenes.scene: Red-scarfed monkey Wukong and pink-snouted blue-robed Bajie follow a winding stream of melting ice below many spring willow trees, meeting a comically rumpled elderly local earth spirit with a braided white beard.

scenes.title: 四、神鐵當頭棒欲落，半空祥雲壽星來
scenes.scene: An old local earth spirit points the way. Sun Wukong puts both hands against a huge nine-branched willow, opening a luminous stone arch in its roots. Blue-clothed pig Bajie watches, pastel river and moss, no text on arch.

scenes.title: 五、仙翁笑呵呵拄柺，原是座下白鹿精
scenes.scene: In a magical willow cavern, Sun Wukong in red scarf raises his red staff against a white-haired Daoist's curling wooden staff, while a fully clothed woman in lilac withdraws through a distant doorway. No contact with bodies.

scenes.title: 六、仙杖輕點現原形，收回仙山伴鶴鳴
scenes.scene: The gentle white-bearded God of Longevity with high rounded forehead rides a white crane on pink clouds. His trailing sleeve catches a soft light that shows a white deer taking form below. Red-scarfed Wukong and blue-clothed Bajie look on.

scenes.title: 七、千名幼童歸家室，比丘改名小兒城
scenes.scene: In a court garden the white-bearded God of Longevity offers one red jujube to a remorseful seated king. A serene white deer stands beside the immortal while Wukong and Tang observe under willow branches.

scenes.title: 一、黑松林中陰森森，忽聞女子救命聲
scenes.scene: Families reunite with safe children outside the sunlit stone gates of Bhikshu, colorful bamboo baskets rest open nearby. Four pilgrims and the white horse watch with relief, warm spring day.

scenes.title: 二、金繩捆綁嬌滴女，自稱落難遭強徒
scenes.scene: Golden sunlight filters into a deep pine forest. Red-scarfed Wukong clears low vines with his staff, Tang monk rides a white horse and blue-clothed pig Bajie and bearded Sha follow. A quiet mossy trail and layered trees.

scenes.title: 三、長老慈悲命解救，行者冷眼辨妖氛
scenes.scene: Deep in pine woods a fully clothed adult woman in lavender tied loosely by decorative golden cords to a tree asks for help. Tang monk in red kasaya bows in concern; Wukong watches dark mist above her from a distant branch. No distressing details.

scenes.title: 四、白骨前車猶未遠，師父執意帶同程
scenes.scene: Tang monk asks pig Bajie to release the fully clothed woman from a loosely knotted gold cord on the tree. Sun Wukong descends on a small pale cloud with red scarf, warning them by holding up a palm. No harm.

scenes.title: 五、日暮投宿禪林寺，住持開門接僧行
scenes.scene: Tang monk and companions depart on a pine forest path while red-scarfed Wukong explains the dark magical mist he saw, shown only as a faint curl between distant branches. Woman tiny and safe in distance, no conflict.

scenes.title: 六、女子安歇後院室，三日不食色更嬌
scenes.scene: Tang monk on a white horse pauses in a dark pine wood, looking back toward an indistinct voice, while Wukong, Bajie and Sha look at one another in confusion. Late afternoon, four travelers only.

scenes.title: 七、寺中小僧連失蹤，大聖深夜伏佛堂
scenes.scene: A fully clothed woman in lavender rides the white horse, blue-clothed Bajie leads the reins, Tang monk walks ahead, bearded Sha carries baggage, and Wukong watches carefully from behind. Sunbeams through deep pines.

scenes.title: 一、夜深寺中鐘鼓寂，女妖推門步輕盈
scenes.scene: Lantern-lit reception chamber at an ancient Zen monastery. A kindly gray-robed abbot approaches the seated four travelers at their vegetarian meal; a fully clothed woman in muted lavender sits separately. Architecture, warm food and hospitality.

scenes.title: 二、大聖化作小沙彌，端坐蒲團念真經
scenes.scene: Ancient monastery courtyard by night. A gray-robed monk shows a fully clothed woman in lavender to a quiet separate guest hall with lantern. In next morning scene only Tang in red robe rests in bed while concerned Wukong checks on him. Choose the morning bedside as sole scene.

scenes.title: 三、妖精嬌笑撲懷抱，行者冷笑現真容
scenes.scene: Sun Wukong in red scarf carries a wooden water bowl through monastery corridors and notices two young adult novice monks in gray robes looking worried. Soft yellow window light, clearly a safe conversation.

scenes.title: 四、金箍棒起風雷動，雙股神劍化金芒
scenes.scene: Two worried gray-clothed young adult novice monks talk to Wukong beside a giant hanging bronze bell in monastery grounds. Wukong raises a reassuring palm, foggy night in imagined background, no violence.

scenes.title: 五、脫下一隻繡花鞋，化作替身遁夜空
scenes.scene: Wukong in a complete human disguise as a young adult novice sits by a night monastery altar on a rush mat, near large temple bell, as mysterious dark mist gathers beyond the doors. Soft lanterns, gentle suspense, no woman yet.

scenes.title: 六、狂風捲走唐三藏，寺僧驚哭求大聖
scenes.scene: Red-scarfed golden monkey Wukong blocks two glimmering fantasy sword blades with his iconic red staff in a spacious Buddhist hall, facing a fully covered lavender-robed adult mouse sorceress. Static moment of contact between implements only; no injury.

scenes.title: 七、八戒沙僧齊揮杖，誓入深山尋師尊
scenes.scene: At night behind the temple, one small embroidered purple shoe glows on the stone path as a fully clothed lavender-robed sorceress's translucent look-alike distracts Wukong. The real sorceress flees into mist in distant background. No injury.

scenes.title: 一、陷空山前尋洞口，碗口小眼深千丈
scenes.scene: In blue midnight light Wukong stands on the tiled ridge of a monastery roof calling to gray-robed monks who gather below with paper lanterns. No Tang monk, no demons, no words or text.

scenes.title: 二、大聖化作小飛蚊，順風旋轉入深淵
scenes.scene: Among dark pines Wukong, pig Bajie and bearded Sha meet two elder local spirits, mountain spirit and earth spirit, who point south through the forest. No Tang monk; shafts of atmospheric morning light.

scenes.title: 三、洞底別有天日照，亭台樓閣水潺潺
scenes.scene: Wide view of towering Xian Kong Mountain, twisting pines on cliffs, waterfall and flowers on the sunny side and patches of snow in shadow. Three tiny travelers approach via ridge, no Tang monk.

scenes.title: 四、長老被鎖後花園，妖女勸飲交杯酒
scenes.scene: A dark wild boar, transformed Bajie, quietly peers from behind boulders as two fully clothed adult attendants, one red and one green, carry baskets up a mountain trail and talk. No other pilgrims visible.

scenes.title: 五、行者穿過迴廊處，忽見金爐香煙裊
scenes.scene: Monkey King, blue-clothed pig Bajie and bearded Sha discover a broad round well-like opening in smooth bare rock at the top of a mountain. Three lean to look at a safe distance, no inscriptions or other figures.

scenes.title: 六、供奉托塔李天王，哪吒三太子神位
scenes.scene: Sun Wukong in red scarf descends through a vast dark rocky well into a small pool of golden light below. His red scarf flutters and he controls the descent like a diver. No other people and no injury.

scenes.title: 七、大聖大喜拍手笑，天兵救兵在眼前
scenes.scene: Fantastic underground paradise with flowing streams, peach blossoms and an elegant bamboo pavilion. Tiny glowing fly disguised Wukong near the foreground, one fully clothed adult woman in lavender sits in pavilion in distance.

scenes.title: 一、金牌抱在懷中抱，大聖縱身駕雲霄
scenes.scene: In a cavern garden room, Tang monk is seated in red robe with a minuscule magical fly beside his ear as he listens closely. Bamboo lattice, flowering branches, doorway beyond. Only Tang monk and the fly.

scenes.title: 二、凌霄寶殿遞狀紙，天王怒拔寶劍迎
scenes.scene: At a sparse vegetarian banquet in an underground garden, Tang monk tips a long-spouted teapot into a gold goblet, a tiny hidden magical fly under the bright foam. Fully clothed lavender-robed adult hostess watches. Quiet concentration.

scenes.title: 三、哪吒三太子勸父，想起當年靈山事
scenes.scene: Close-up of a minuscule black fly afloat safely on the surface of a golden goblet; fully clothed lavender-robed adult sorceress and Tang monk in red robe gaze at it with surprised expressions in soft focus, garden setting.

scenes.title: 四、白鼠偷食佛前油，天王饒命收義女
scenes.scene: In underground peach garden, Tang monk shows a single extraordinarily ripe red peach to a smiling fully clothed adult lavender-robed mouse sorceress. Green peaches on leafy branches above, no other figures, no suggestive posing.

scenes.title: 五、天王抱愧謝大聖，親率天兵下凡塵
scenes.scene: A startled fully clothed adult lavender-robed sorceress sits on a stone bench and puts one hand on her belly, while calm Tang monk looks on and a separate amber cloud vignette shows tiny Wukong practicing a playful martial-arts pose. Abstract magic, no anatomy or injury.

scenes.title: 六、天羅地網鎖深洞，神將搜山捉妖精
scenes.scene: At the opening of a mountain cavern, a fully clothed adult lavender-robed sorceress helps Tang monk safely down from a piggyback ride. Pig Bajie and bearded Sha hurry forward to receive him and lower their fantasy staffs. No other persons, gentle whole-body composition.

scenes.title: 七、金鼻白毛終被擒，師徒重聚赴西程
scenes.scene: Outside a rocky cave Tang monk is now safe beside Bajie and Sha, while red-scarfed Wukong appears from a golden mist alongside the fully clothed lavender-robed mouse sorceress. Show reunion and mutual surprise in an intact group, no bodily contact, no injury.
